notes.title: Launch Event: Double drops!
notes.content:
LAUNCH EVENT IS LIVE! 


Hey everyone! We’re rolling out a brand new update that makes claiming items twice as fast! 



That means your waifu can now walk away with twice as many goodies from the store in the same amount of time! 



This event runs until July 2nd, 2025, at 3:00 PM Eastern Standard Time, so make sure to take advantage while it lasts!


New Task Available!
Check it out in your task list and grab those rewards!


Bug Fixes:
Fixed a visual bug where merged items would still appear in your inventory. Everything should look correct now!





Go treat your waifu. She deserves it.

Let us know what you think, and happy collecting!

notes.title: Bug Fixes 1.01
notes.content:
Bug Fixes 

1. Some shirts were previously unable to be equipped. This has now been fixed.

2. On load, some inventory images were showing as blank. This has now been fixed.
